forum.title: EPR request in STM32G071
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello

I have good news - during test (with ST and AI support) I have done changes:

In stm32g0xx\_it.c file in function: void TIM17\_IRQHandler(void) I have added: USBPD\_DPM\_TimerCounter();

In case USBPD\_CORE\_DATATYPE\_RCV\_SRC\_PDO\_EPR:

```

{

uint8_t x=1; //hardcoded PDO EPR from source position

uint32_t EPR=0;

DPM_USER_DEBUG_TRACE(PortNum, "EPR - received: %lu bytes, %d PDOs", Size, Number_Of_EPR_PDO);

(void)memcpy(&EPR, Ptr+(x*4U), 4U);

DPM_USER_DEBUG_TRACE(PortNum, "x: %d - EPR: 0x%08lX", x, EPR);

USBPD_SRCProgrammablePowerSupplyAVSPDO_TypeDef PDO;

uint8_t src_power;

uint8_t src_max_voltage;

uint8_t src_min_voltage;

(void)memcpy(&PDO, &EPR, sizeof(PDO));

src_power = PDO.PDPIn1W;

src_min_voltage=PDO.MinVoltageIn100mV/10;

src_max_voltage=PDO.MaxVoltageIn100mV/10;

DPM_USER_DEBUG_TRACE(PortNum, "EPR: %d W, Max %d V", src_power, src_max_voltage);

if((EPR&0b11000000000000000000000000000000UL)!=0b11000000000000000000000000000000UL) //if not AVS

{

DPM_USER_DEBUG_TRACE(PortNum, "0x%08lX", EPR);

EPR_Voltage=(EPR>>10);

EPR_Voltage=EPR_Voltage&0b00000000000000000000001111111111;

EPR_Voltage=EPR_Voltage*50;

EPR_Current=EPR&0b00000000000000000000001111111111;

EPR_Current=EPR_Current*10; //prąd w mA

DPM_USER_DEBUG_TRACE(PortNum, "EPR = %lu mV, %lu mA", EPR_Voltage, EPR_Current);

}

if((EPR&0b11000000000000000000000000000000UL)==0b11000000000000000000000000000000UL) //if AVS

{

DPM_USER_DEBUG_TRACE(PortNum, "0x%08lX", EPR);

uint32_t Max_Voltage_100mV=(EPR>>17);

Max_Voltage_100mV =  Max_Voltage_100mV&0b00000000000000000000000111111111;

DPM_USER_DEBUG_TRACE(PortNum, "EPR AVS - max voltage: %lu mV", (Max_Voltage_100mV*100));

}

}

break;

```
